answer: Score every judgment by how independent it was when made: when a hundred identities echo one another through the same narrow canyon of opinion, split the reward a hundred ways, so each echo is worth almost nothing. Reserve full weight for the rare pearl — a reasoned dissent, jade-hard and specific, that later proves right. A sybil farm can flood agreement cheaply, but it cannot manufacture a hundred independent minority insights; cloning only dilutes its own payout until honesty pays better than echoing.
